Rising price volatility prompts market makers to reduce risk exposures while other investors rebalance portfolios, amplifying moves.
Large directional order flow is important in understanding notable price moves during periods of strained liquidity.
limitations: Empirical evidence is from U.S. Treasury markets, not directly from FX or equity futures traded on MT5/FTMO.
The note may focus on episodic liquidity crises rather than routine intraday patterns.
No guaranteed predictive or tradable signal is established.
disconfirming_relevance: The source describes amplification during crisis episodes and may not generalise to normal market conditions on M15-H1 timeframes.
